name: nur-namaz-uygulamasi
description: NUR Namaz Uygulaması Android ve iOS mobil kabuğu

scripts.prepare:web: node scripts/prepare-web.mjs && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.cjs -i styles/tailwind.input.css -o www/assets/tailwind.css --minify
scripts.android:add: npm run prepare:web && cap add android
scripts.android:open: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.android:build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
